title: Smoky Sausage with Sauerkraut and Potatoes
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring smoky sausage, sauerkraut, and crispy potatoes.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the sauerkraut, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the smoky sausage to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Serve the sausage and sauerkraut mixture hot, garnished with additional caraway seeds if desired.
